note: Syllabus rows that a lab EXISTS for but that must NOT count as built, because the lab covers only part of what the row lists. tools/prayog_claim.py enforces this: a revoked row is never counted, even if a later claim names it.

revoked.phase-shift-oscillator: row says 'with a BJT'; the lab draws an op-amp amplifier
revoked.passive-filters: row lists low pass, high pass AND band pass; the labs cover low and high pass only
revoked.logic-gates: row lists NAND and NOR realisations; the lab is NAND only
revoked.sonometer-frequency: row lists an electrically maintained tuning fork AND AC mains; the lab covers mains only
revoked.neutron-activation: the lab measures the product half-life only, not the neutron flux the row is about
revoked.langmuir-probe: row lists an argon RF discharge; the lab models only the DC glow
